narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of Tobias in a plain, reverent manner.

tobias-the-younger.name: Tobias the younger
tobias-the-younger.note: The son: dutiful, earnest, a little fearful on his first journey.

angel-raphael.name: The angel Raphael
angel-raphael.note: Sent by God, travelling as the young man Azarias: calm, assured, instructing.

raguel.name: Raguel
raguel.note: Father of Sara, kinsman of Tobias: warm, tearful, anxious for his daughter.

anna-wife-of-raguel.name: Anna, wife of Raguel
anna-wife-of-raguel.note: Mother of Sara (Edna in some Bibles): comforting her weeping daughter.

1.t: And they went in to Raguel, and Raguel received them with joy.

2.t: And Raguel looking upon Tobias, said to Anna his wife:
How like is this young man to my cousin?

3.t: And when he had spoken these words, he said:
Whence are ye young men our brethren?

4.t: We are of the tribe of Nephtali, of the captivity of Ninive.
4.q: Tobias and the angel answer together; given to Tobias as their spokesman

5.t: Do you know Tobias my brother?

5.q: Tobias and the angel answer together; given to Tobias as their spokesman

6.t: And when he was speaking many good things of him, the angel said to Raguel:
Tobias concerning whom thou inquirest is this young man's father.

7.t: And Raguel went to him, and kissed him with tears and weeping upon his neck, said:
A blessing be upon thee, my son, because thou art the son of a good and most virtuous man.

8.t: And Anna his wife, and Sara their daughter wept.

9.t: And after they had spoken, Raguel commanded a sheep to be killed, and a feast to be prepared. And when he desired them to sit down to dinner,

10.t: I will not eat nor drink here this day, unless thou first grant me my petition, and promise to give me Sara thy daughter.

11.t: Now when Raguel heard this he was afraid, knowing what had happened to those seven husbands, that went in unto her: and he began to fear lest it might happen to him also in like manner: and as he was in suspense, and gave no answer to his petition,

12.t: Be not afraid to give her to this man, for to him who feareth God is thy daughter due to be his wife: therefore another could not have her.

13.t: I doubt not but God hath regarded my prayers and tears in his sight.

14.t: And I believe he hath therefore made you come to me, that this maid might be married to one of her own kindred, according to the law of Moses: and now doubt not but I will give her to thee.

15.t: And taking the right hand of his daughter, he gave it into the right hand of Tobias, saying:
The God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob be with you, and may he join you together, and fulfil his blessing in you.

16.t: And taking paper they made a writing of the marriage.

17.t: And afterwards they made merry, blessing God.

18.t: And Raguel called to him Anna his wife, and bade her to prepare another chamber.

19.t: And she brought Sara her daughter in thither, and she wept.

20.t: Be of good cheer, my daughter: the Lord of heaven give thee joy for the trouble thou hast undergone.
